dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I thought you were the most special person I ever met. Someone who could love me and understand me in a way that no one else could.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: You promised to always protect me. That you would never let anyone hurt me.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: You noticed everything about me, it made me feel so seen.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: Even now, you're the only one who can make it stop hurting.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: Because you're the only one who can make me hurt so bad, the only one who can break my heart like this.

glossary.label: What is the trauma bond & neurochemical addiction?
glossary.body: Alternating cycles of high-intensity fear and violence followed by overwhelming affection release a rollercoaster of stress hormones and neurochemicals (oxytocin and dopamine), creating a powerful psychological addiction that makes leaving feel like severe physical withdrawal and keeps victims attached to the very person causing their pain.

steps.quote: You promised to always protect me.
…the only one who can make me hurt so bad.
You're the only one who can make it stop hurting.

glossary.note: The sweet memories are real. That's exactly what makes it so hard to leave.
